'''Gross Revenue''' was a subdivision of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Financial Division]]. It was responsible for tracking the Authority's assets, resources, expenses, and income. Gross Revenue was also responsible for predicting future economic trends both inside and outside the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
